title: Drift finding
description: L3-D2 role 'Drift finding' (lanes/L3-06-tasks.md L3-D2 table; contracts_map.py CONTRACTS key drift_finding). The object every reconciler comparator emits. Shape copied verbatim from the already-shipped reconciler.model.Finding dataclass (reconciler/model.py) - this schema documents that shape as a frozen contract rather than inventing a new one. Spec anchors: Section 53.1 ('Every drift finding carries an acknowledged_by and acknowledged_at field'; the external-cause paragraph); Section 53.4 (the one drift severity scale and its four members); Section 53.2 (the five response levels).

id.description: The finding's own id, unique within a run (e.g. carries a ':missing' / ':unassigned' direction suffix for some comparators - see reconciler/repair/team_sync.py).

comparator.description: The comparator id that produced this finding, e.g. org_membership, team_membership, branch_protection, environments.

scope.description: What the finding is about: a product id, a 'product:login' pair, a repository name, or another comparator-defined scope string.

drift_class.description: Section 53.4's one severity scale (reconciler.model.DriftClass). No fifth member. Security drift and production-environment drift are never classified below Red (reconciler.model.security_floor).

level.description: Section 53.2's response level (reconciler.model.Level): 1=Detect, 2=Warn, 3=Auto-repair, 4=Block, 5=Escalate. Green/Amber/Blocking resolve to a level directly from Section 53.2's stated 'Applies to' text; Red resolves through contracts/reconciler/level-map.yaml (DEC-L3-02-01).

evidence.description: The declared-versus-actual evidence for this finding, in whatever form the comparator recorded it.

first_seen.description: Timestamp the finding was first observed. Age against the finding's drift_class response time (Section 53.4) is measured from this field.

acknowledged_by.description: Section 53.1: every drift finding carries an acknowledged_by field. Null until a human acknowledges it (reconciler/annotations.py).

acknowledged_at.description: Section 53.1: every drift finding carries an acknowledged_at field. Null until acknowledged.

external_cause.description: Section 53.1's external-cause paragraph: names an outage or other external cause and marks the run for re-execution.

gap_window.description: Section 53.7: every record produced during a control-loop gap window is marked gap-window until re-verified.
